analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 4 consecutive sessions. RSI continues to fluctuate between the low 40s and below 50, staying in neutral territory. Trading volume at 0.83x the 5-day average indicates a lack of conviction, suggesting a phase of directional exploration.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($105,610) vs SMA5 ($107,083)/SMA20 ($102,369)/SMA50 ($132,211): mixed signals with price below short-term SMA5, above mid-term SMA20, and below long-term SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100 ($140,924)/SMA200 ($102,395): indicating a weak mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (34.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.4 → 47.1) + exiting oversold territory and continuing in the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (3984.3969 → 2724.8476) + showing improvement in negative territory but still weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $102,369) + with a band width of 29.25% indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($68,045) + Pivot S1 ($87,137) acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($115,010) + Pivot R1 ($123,597) acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: sideways range, no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.83x) + indicating low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + maintaining a wait-and-see approach in a directional exploration phase.
